# Cluster To Array promotes numeric fields

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

I16 and I32 fields promote to the resolver's common I32 element type. Field order determines array order; stable field IDs remain in the original Cluster.

## What this example demonstrates

I16 and I32 fields promote to the resolver's common I32 element type. Field order determines array order; stable field IDs remain in the original Cluster.
